description: Header file defining the BufferVk class and related structures for Vulkan buffer management in ANGLE project, including buffer operations, conversion buffers, and internal data handling.

classes.name: BufferVk
classes.description: Class implementing Vulkan buffer operations, derived from BufferImpl, managing buffer data, mapping, copying, and conversion buffers.

classes.name: ConversionBuffer
classes.description: Struct for holding translated index and vertex data buffers, with state tracking for re-streaming and last allocation offset.

classes.name: VertexConversionBuffer
classes.description: Derived struct from ConversionBuffer, adding format, stride, and offset info for vertex data conversion caching.

methods.name: BufferVk
methods.description: Constructor initializing BufferVk with buffer state.

methods.name: setSubData
methods.description: Updates a subset of buffer data.

methods.name: mapRange
methods.description: Maps a range of the buffer.

methods.name: getBuffer
methods.description: Returns constant reference to internal BufferHelper.

methods.name: mapRangeImpl
methods.description: Implementation for mapping a range of buffer.

methods.name: getVertexConversionBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a vertex conversion buffer.

methods.name: markConversionBuffersDirty
methods.description: Marks conversion buffers as dirty for re-encoding.

methods.name: VertexConversionBuffer
methods.description: Constructor for vertex conversion buffer with format, stride, and offset.
